# Documentation image exporter

`html-to-image.js` is the unmodified UMD distribution of
[html-to-image 1.11.13](https://www.npmjs.com/package/html-to-image/v/1.11.13).
Its MIT license is included as `html-to-image.LICENSE`.

Only `qa/readme-capture.html` loads this library. It exports the visible game
interface and original Canvas images as PNG at twice the CSS resolution.
It is not part of the game runtime or the hosted `dist/` directory.
